spans.s: द्रु vt. or vi. 1P (pp. द्रुत; pres. द्रवति; desid. दुद्रूषति) 1. To flow, to run, to run away, to retreat, to fly (often with an acc.) यथा नदीनां बहवोंबुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखं द्रवंति Bg.xi.28, रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवंति 36; 2. to rush, to attack, to assault quickly, Bt.ix.59; 3. to become fluid, to dissolve, to melt, Bt.ii.12, Sis.ix.9.With अनु-, to follow, to run after, R.iii.38, xii.67.With अभि-, to attack, गजा इवान्योन्यमभुद्रवंतः Mrich.v.; 2. to befall.With उप-, to attack, R.xv.23.With प्र-, to run, to run away, to retreat, (with an acc. generally), Bt.xv.79.With प्रति-, to run to, to go to, Bt.vi.17.With वि-, to run, to ran away, to retreat.
द्रु (II) vt. 5P (pres. द्रुणोति) 1. To hurt, to injure, तं दुद्रायाद्रिणा कपिः Bt.xiv.81, 85; 2. to repent; 3. to go.
द्रु Caus. (द्रावयति-ते) 1. to put to flight; 2. to fuse.With वि-, to tear, to scatter, Bh.V.i.52.
द्रु (I) m.n. 1. Wood; 2. any instrument made of wood.
द्रु (II) m. 1. A tree, M.viii.131; 2. a branch.
द्रू m. Gold.
द्रु-किलिम n. the Devadāru tree.
द्रु-घण m. 1. a mallet, a wooden mace; 2. an iron weapon made like a carpenter’s hammer; 3. an axe, a hatchet; 4. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
द्रूघण m. A hammer.
द्रु-घ्नी f. a hatchet.
द्रु-नख m. a thorn.
द्रु-सल्लक m. the piyāla tree.
द्रुण (I) m. 1. A scorpion; 2. a bee; 3. a rogue.
द्रुण (II) n. 1. A bow; 2. a sword.
द्रुणा f. A bowstring.
द्रूण m. A scorpion.
द्रुण-ह m. a sheath, a scabbard.
द्रुणि f. 1. A small tortoise; 2. a bucket; 3. a centipede.
द्रुणि f. 1. A small tortoise; 2. a bucket; 3. a centipede.
द्रुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Quick, speedy; 2. flown, run away; 3. liquid, dissolved, (pp. of द्रु I q.v.).
द्रुत (II) m. 1. A scorpion; 2. a tree; 3. a cat.(द्रुतम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘quickly, speedily, immediately.’)
द्रुत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Quick, speedy; 2. flown, run away; 3. liquid, dissolved, (pp. of द्रु I q.v.).
द्रुत-विलंबित m. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
द्रुति f. 1. Melting, dissolving; 2. going, running away.
द्रुपद m. Name of a king. (See App. II.)
द्रुपद-आत्मज m. an epithet (1) of Śikhaṇḍin, (2) of Dhṛṣṭadyumna.
द्रुपद-आत्मजा f. an epithet of Draupadī.
द्रुम m. 1. A tree, R.xi.23; 2. a tree of paradise.
द्रुम-अरि m. an elephant.
द्रुम-आमय m. lac, gum.
द्रुम-आश्रय m. a lizard.
द्रुम-ईश्वर m. 1. the palm tree; 2. the moon.
द्रुम-उत्पल m. the karṇikāra tree.
द्रुम-नख, -मर m. a thorn.
द्रुम-नख, -मर m. a thorn.
द्रुम-व्याधि m. lac, gum.
द्रुम-श्रेष्ठ m. the palm tree.
द्रुम-षंड n. a grove of trees.
द्रुमिणी f. An assemblage of trees.
द्रुवय n. A measure.

द्रुह् vt. 4P (pp. द्रुग्ध; pres. द्रुह्यति) To bear malice or Hatred, to seek to hurt or injure, to plot maliciously, to meditate mischief (generally with the dat. of the object of hatred, e.g. हरये द्रुह्यति), Bt.iv.39.With अभि-, to do injury to, (with acc.), e.g. मच्छरीरमभिद्रोग्धुम् Mud.i.
द्रुह (I) a. (at the end of compounds) (nom. sing. धुक्-ग्, धुट्-ड्) Injuring, acting as an enemy against, M.v.90.
द्रुह (II) f. Injury, damage.
द्रुह m. 1. A son; 2. a lake.
द्रुहण m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).
द्रुहण m. An epithet of Brahman (m.).
